Moves

Numerals and features

Plan the weekPlan the week

The contrast is horizontal, not vertical: no heavy/thin weight pair, no colour.
Signature
One headline, one weight, two widths: the verb phrase in width 75, the noun in width 125. It replaces the usual heavy-plus-thin weight pair and the coloured keyword.
Use when
Product sites and apps that would otherwise get the default wide grotesk: planners, editors, team tools.
Turns into slop when
When every heading gets the width swap, when the wide word is also coloured, or when the whole line is set wide at 800 with tight tracking (that is the house default this recipe replaces).
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
